## FAQs

#### What is CRM software?

Customer relationship management (CRM) encompasses the people, processes, and technology required to activate your company’s relationships prospects and customers. A CRM system helps companies connect with prospects and customers, reduce manual work and streamline business activity, and ultimately, grow revenue and profitability.

CRM is usually used to denote a CRM system, which is a tool that helps companies with sales and contact management, team productivity, and more.

CRM applications are designed to guide customer relationships through the entire customer lifecycle, spanning marketing, sales, digital commerce, customer service interactions and more; really, any interaction that a business has with prospects and customers.

#### Who should use a CRM?

Any business that handles sales or marketing of products or services can benefit from using a CRM. This includes both B2B and B2C businesses. The teams most likely to use a CRM in any business are Sales, Marketing and Customer Service.

**Sales** – A CRM helps your sales team be well positioned to upsell and cross-sell your products and services. Sales teams can also use click-to-call functions to help save time and make it easy to keep track of all your interactions with prospects and customers so nothing falls into the cracks. They can also generate highly specific quotes as they seek new business and to run reports and invoices for existing customers.

**Marketing** – A CRM helps your marketing team gather valuable information from your customers, making it easier to target marketing efforts precisely and effectively. When you can aim your marketing campaigns at a specific audience, you’re far more likely to reap a good ROI, and you don’t waste the time and money that often results from an undifferentiated marketing campaign, which can end up feeling like spam.

**Customer service** – CRMs help support teams efficiently resolve issues, and make it easy to connect customers to the right person at all times.

#### How can a CRM help me drive more sales for my business?

A CRM helps capture customer data and automate sales functions, so you can create more velocity through your sales process. For example, if you don’t use a CRM, you might be capturing information on notes, or in Google sheets or docs. A CRM helps all your customer-facing teams understand and leverage customer data to help drive sales. It’s even more important in a remote-first or hybrid environment, in which information is best centralized.

#### If I’m running a small business, do I need a CRM?

Absolutely! Companies of all sizes benefit from a CRM. And in fact, if you are a small business, a CRM can help you organize and track pipelines so that you can do more to drive sales. If you have customers, you can benefit from CRM. Even if your customer base is small, no one can track every single interaction and keep all customer status up to date. It’s a powerful business tool that streamlines processes, gives valuable business insights, and virtually connects employees at your company so they can collaborate as a team, in real time. That’s something businesses of any size can use.

#### What support options does Insightly CRM provide?

All Insightly users have access to our support team by phone (Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–4 p.m. PT) or by email, with responses typically within 24 hours.

For faster response times, extended support hours, personalized training, and one-on-one technical guidance, you can upgrade to a [Premier Support and Success Plan](https://www.insightly.com/premier-support-and-success/).

#### What is Insightly AI Copilot and how does it help me work faster?

Insightly’s AI Copilot is an AI-powered assistant built right into the CRM. Using simple prompts, Insightly’s AI Copilot can boost efficiency by automating time-consuming tasks, summarizing records, and surfacing the information you need instantly.

## FAQs

#### What are the benefits of marketing automation?

Marketing automation software saves time and resources by streamlining and automating tasks and processes that marketers would otherwise do manually or not at all. It helps users to save time, produce better results, reduce human error, and use data to target specific groups. At the same time, it can increase your engagement with your leads, help convert more leads faster, provide ROI and data on your campaigns, and show how leads interact with your marketing assets.

#### Is marketing automation only for enterprise companies?

Not at all! Companies of all sizes want to create awareness, generate leads, and communicate with prospects and existing customers. Insightly’s Marketing application makes it easy for large and small companies to align marketing and sales teams around metrics that matter and build their business efficiently.

#### What are some questions I need to think about before adopting a marketing automation application?

There’s a lot to consider when thinking about a new marketing automation tool — first of all, how easily does it integrate with my CRM and my Service application? How easily does it integrate with other apps that I use as a marketer?

You should also think about the processes you plan to automate, the number of campaigns you want to run per month, and whether or not you want to optimize your creative and content through test-and-learn methodologies like A/B and multivariate testing.

You should also start to think about the number of segments you’ll try to reach, and the journey that those segments will go through as you nurture them through your marketing processes.

## FAQs

#### What is Insightly AppConnect?

Insightly AppConnect is an integration automation application that makes it easy to build sophisticated integrations and workflows between Insightly CRM and hundreds of applications you use across your entire organization.

#### Is AppConnect only for large enterprises?

Any organization can benefit from the efficiencies gained by AppConnect. And since AppConnect plans are tiered by the number of tasks, it can be an economical way to automate processes and pass data across applications in your organization.

#### What makes AppConnect a better solution than other integration applications?

Businesses used to have to rely exclusively on developers to write code and create integrations. Insightly’s AppConnect is much newer low-code, no-code technology that’s significantly easier to use, less expensive, and much faster to adopt. What this does is empower business users, marketers, customer success teams, and other stakeholders to create integrations once they see an opportunity that will help make their business move faster and grow.

#### What is an AppConnect recipe?

Recipes are a set of steps that AppConnect will follow to get work done between your apps. A recipe allows AppConnect to interact with another application through a series of triggers and actions. Triggers monitor for events that occur in the application you have connected to. Actions carry out specific predefined operations in the target application. All that said, the outcome of triggers and actions in recipes is that you’re able to quickly and easily create integrations that previously could only have been done much more slowly and for much higher cost using traditional development resources. Our customers have found that AppConnect creates efficiency by automating time-consuming processes and freeing them up to focus their time and energy on other, more important tasks.

## FAQs

#### What is Insightly Service?

Insightly Service is a key part of Insightly’s unified suite of customer relationship management applications. It’s a service and support application that’s built natively within Insightly, connecting seamlessly with all the applications you use today to run your business. What does that mean to you? Mission-critical customer data is available to all your teams, in real time, empowering them to have more relevant conversations that drive customer satisfaction and success.

#### What are the benefits of a customer service application?

You want every interaction your customer service team has with prospects and customers to be a positive one. You can help them achieve that goal by providing a software platform that allows them to close tickets faster and deliver personalized experiences.

#### Should I use Insightly CRM and Service together?

Both Insightly CRM and Insightly Service are robust applications that stand on their own for use by sales teams and customer service teams respectively. Both also integrate with other CRMs and other customer service applications. However, when you implement both, you provide your teams with full visibility into every customer interaction, aligning your teams with a full 360-degree view that will help them elevate the experiences they deliver.

#### Is a customer service application something that only large enterprises need to run their business?

Once you have more than one customer service agent, you can benefit from a customer service application. Some platforms come with high price tags so only large organizations can afford them. Today, there are many affordably priced platforms that are intuitive so that virtually any organization of any size can use this technology.

#### What is an SLA?

A service level agreement (SLA) is a contract between a service provider and a customer that defines the types of service and the standard of service that the provider will provide and that the customer can expect. You can define and manage your organization’s SLAs in Insightly Service.

## FAQs

#### Why should I consider buying Insightly All-in-One?

Insightly’s CRM, Marketing, and Service applications are built to provide comprehensive customer insights for all teams on a single, easy-to-use platform. Many companies say that they offer a platform, when in reality, they’ve purchased a number of disparate applications and bolted them together, making it difficult for teams to adopt the solutions and making it hard to get the most from your data. With Insightly All-in-One, new customers get up to 30% off the cost of Insightly CRM, Marketing, Service, and AppConnect.

#### If I’m an existing customer (If I already have one or two Insightly applications), can I take advantage of bundled pricing?

You can certainly benefit by having your organization adopting the entire platform. However, since you already own one or more Insightly solutions, allow us to provide a custom pricing option that will provide value and benefits that will best meet your unique needs. Please contact your CSM or sales@insightly.com to see what might work best for you.

## Insightly CRM Pricing Structure
Insightly CRM does not have a freemium. It has three subscription plans: Plus, Professional, and Enterprise.

Features are spread across each tier, and there are no add-ons or extras to extend any functionality. That means if a plan doesn’t have what you need, you’ll either have to upgrade, integrate a third-party app, or find a different CRM for your small business.

### How Much Does Insightly CRM Cost?
The lowest plan (Plus) covers the basics you’d expect of a CRM for small business. But at $29 per user/month, it’s more expensive than most other alternatives.

![insightly crm pricing plans](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-pricing.C09UgHVq_Z1lPw4A.webp)![insightly crm pricing plans](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-pricing.C09UgHVq_Z1lPw4A.webp)

Even more so, when you consider that it lacks workflow automations and email sequences. For this, you’ll need to opt for the next plan (Professional), which is also overpriced ($49 per user/month) and still doesn’t feature any email sequences.

And it makes no difference if you decide to opt for the Enterprise subscription at $99 per seat/month. Email sequencing doesn’t exist in this CRM. Period. If the functionality is important to you, you have three choices:

Insightly does not offer a freemium plan, but it does provide a 14-day free trial. The trial, however, gives you access to the Professional plan features, regardless of whether you are interested in the lowest or highest tier.

One good thing about Insightly is its generosity with file storage. The small business CRM provides 10GB of space on the lowest plan, and more than 10 times that amount on the higher subscriptions.

### Is Insightly an Affordable CRM for Small Business?
At $29 per user each month, Insightly is almost twice the price of many small-business CRMs.

You would expect premium features for that cost, but email sequences are not even included. Many competing CRMs at half the price offer that as a standard feature.

The same applies to a core tool like workflow automation. If you’ll be needing that, you’ll have to move up to the $49 per user/month plan. For a small team of five people, that comes to $245 per month. That is a steep bill for functionality that [cheaper CRMs](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/best-affordable-crms/) include right out of the box.

Insightly only offers a 14-day trial, which is often not enough time to properly import your data, get set up, and test how the system works for your team.

## Best Alternative for Insightly CRM
**Value:** High

**Pricing starts from**: $9.95

At $9.95 per user/month, you’re paying about a third of Insightly’s cost, and you still get access to workflow automations.

## The simple CRM that does the job
21-day free trial • No credit card required • Simple setup

# Insightly CRM Review 2026

We thoroughly tested Insightly as a small business CRM. Read this CRM review to see whether it meets your everyday business needs.

![](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/sam-headshot.wsfmr8nW_2dLVf7.webp)

Samuel Oyebode [Samuel Oyebode on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/samuel-oyebode-b62419213)Last tested July 8, 2026

You found [Insightly CRM](https://www.onepagecrm.com/crm-alternatives/insightly/) while searching for a way to manage your sales and customer relationships. You’re on the right track, but you might not actually need everything this small business CRM wants to charge you for.

Insightly attempts to be more than just a CRM. It wants to manage your entire business process from first contact through project completion. But does trying to do everything mean it does them particularly well?

We put Insightly through extensive testing to determine whether the feature-packed platform makes sense for small businesses or if its complexity disqualifies it as a CRM for small business.

Insightly is recommended for small businesses that:

- need project management alongside CRM capabilities,
- want extensive reporting and dashboard features,
- look for an all-in-one platform similar to HubSpot but cheaper,
- require lots of file storage space.

Insightly is not recommended for small businesses that:

- prefer a stripped-down CRM without extra modules,
- have limited budgets,
- want a system that is quick and easy to set up,
- rely on email sequences,
- need access to workflow automation on a lower-tier plan.

## Overview of Insightly CRM for Small Business

Insightly wants to be your complete business platform. Not just a CRM, but a system that manages sales, projects, and everything in between.

The basic [CRM features](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/crm-features/) work fine. You can track contacts, manage leads, and monitor sales opportunities. But Insightly doesn’t stop there. It adds project management, time tracking, and advanced reporting on top of the standard CRM features.

![insightly crm home page](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-homepage.D_aqmDxj_Z1DX5MA.webp)![insightly crm home page](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-homepage.D_aqmDxj_Z1DX5MA.webp)

You can track a lead, close the sale, and then manage the entire project delivery without switching tools. Everything stays connected, and your team has one system to learn.

However, this [small business CRM software](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/best-crm-for-small-business/) comes with a number of problems.

The interface has up to twelve navigation tabs, making it considerably more complex than focused CRM solutions. Setup and configuration can stretch into several weeks, rather than days. And despite all these features, Insightly somehow manages to leave out email sequencing entirely.

The CRM software does include email marketing as part of its all-in-one package, but the cost is steep. Pricing starts at $349 per month, covers only two CRM users, and requires a $1,500 onboarding fee.

Even if you want to stick to their CRM product, the pricing for that can be off-putting, as well. Starting at $29 per user/month, Insightly costs significantly more than most small business CRMs, yet still requires upgrades or third-party integrations for basic capabilities like workflow automation.

Insightly is also owned by Unbounce, another marketing automation platform. So, while it’s a powerful tool, it’s not built purely with small-business CRM needs in mind.

It’s a lot to think about, but if you need an all-in-one platform and don’t mind the high price, Insightly may just work for you.

## Insightly CRM Pros and Cons

Let’s take a closer look at what Insightly CRM gets right and where it falls short.

Pros

- 10GB file storage on the lowest plan
- Built-in project management and time tracking
- Extensive reporting and customizable dashboards
- AI assistant for email summaries and replies
- Business card scanner in the mobile app
- Equal support across all pricing tiers

Cons

- No email sequencing on any plan
- Expensive starting price ($29/user/month)
- No freemium option available
- Overwhelming interface with up to 12 navigation tabs
- Requires months to learn, according to G2 reviews
- No workflow automation on the lowest plan

## Key CRM Features of Insightly CRM

Insightly’s Plus plan is the entry plan most small businesses will look at. It covers the basics well, but several advanced tools are held back for higher tiers.

The table below breaks down what you actually get with Insightly’s Plus plan ($29/month per user).

| Core Features |
| Mobile app | Yes |
| Contact management | Yes |
| Follow-up tracking | No |
| Pipelines | YesUnlimited |
| Duplicate management | Yes |
| Centralization Tools |
| Centralized workspaceiDefinition: A centralized workspace is an essential small business CRM feature that lets you manage your whole business on just one page. | No |
| Dashboard | Yes |
| Number of integrations | 540+ |
| Communication Tools |
| Two-way email sync | Yes |
| Click-to-call options | Yes |
| Multi-channel inbox | No |
| Meeting scheduling | No |
| Simple Automation |
| CRM workflows | PartlyUpper plan only |
| Sales email sequences | No |

| Browser extension for auto lead capture | PartlyGmail only |
| Customer Support |

| Live chat | Yes |

| Pricing |
| Starting price | $29 per seat/month |

What Insightly includes, by feature group. The first column names the feature; the second is what Insightly gives you.

Below, we’ll examine the features in detail.

### Contact Management

Insightly CRM lets you add up to 100,000 contacts, organize them on your contact list, and manage them from there.

You can edit, merge, clone, and delete contacts or change their owners. You can also send emails, add new opportunities and projects, and create new tasks, activities, or events.

![insightly crm contact list](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-contact-list-1.DMYqCZHp_Z1qlGAD.webp)![insightly crm contact list](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-contact-list-1.DMYqCZHp_Z1qlGAD.webp)

Click on the contact’s name to open up the sidebar containing their entire journey. There, you can view and edit the contact’s profile. You can add comments or notes, create activities, share files, send and receive emails, and keep a log of almost everything.

![insightly crm full contact profile](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-contact-profile-1.C1-oQJV6_ZlcPaj.webp)![insightly crm full contact profile](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-contact-profile-1.C1-oQJV6_ZlcPaj.webp)

You can also view related projects and opportunities, and update their stages (or status) with a click.

It’s worth noting that Insightly CRM, like many enterprise-level CRMs, differentiates between contacts and leads. The Contacts module works more like a database, where you store and manage the profiles of people and organizations. The Leads module, on the other hand, is where you manage potential customers who are not yet qualified.

You can change a contact to a lead and qualify it for your sales process. If it meets your requirements, it becomes a sales opportunity. And if it fails the qualification process, you can change it back to a contact.

### Task Management

Activities in Insightly CRM are managed using two different tabs: Task and Calendar.

In the former tab, you can create new tasks and set their due dates and priority. You can also create reminders and update the progress of each task. If you switch to the Compact view, you’ll see a list of all your tasks, grouped by “overdue tasks”, “today”, and “later tasks”.

![organized tasks in insightly crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-task-list.co2q3zSh_Zq19op.webp)![organized tasks in insightly crm](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-task-list.co2q3zSh_Zq19op.webp)

The Calendar tab mainly lets you create and view events (like meetings and appointments) on your plate, but it can be configured to show tasks, as well.

![insightly crm event calendar](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-event-calendar.Ws32IXRu_2pwEAL.webp)![insightly crm event calendar](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-event-calendar.Ws32IXRu_2pwEAL.webp)

While these features cover the basics, they fall short as a true [follow-up tracking](https://www.onepagecrm.com/features/take-action/) system.

An ideal setup would link every activity to a lead or opportunity, organize all activities in one place with clear color coding and urgency levels, prompt you to create the next step when one is completed, and send reminders whenever something is due.

While Insightly CRM has a robust task management functionality, the fact that these tasks don’t have to be linked to CRM records means that your to-do list can become cluttered pretty fast.

### Pipeline Management

Insightly CRM allows you to create multiple pipelines and customize them as you deem fit.

You can create pipelines for sales opportunities, as well as projects. And with this CRM’s flexibility, you’re able to configure the stages of these pipelines.

![insightly crm pipeline settings](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-pipeline-configuration.B61bv-F2_1tIFr7.webp)![insightly crm pipeline settings](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-pipeline-configuration.B61bv-F2_1tIFr7.webp)

### Lead Management

Insightly CRM does not include traditional deal management, but it does provide lead management functionality.

This module lists all your leads in a table, arranges them in alphabetical order, and includes some of their basic information.

Clicking on a name on that list opens a sidebar that shows their full journey. From here, you can view and edit details, update statuses, add notes and comments, create activities, share files, and send or receive emails. The system also keeps a record of all emails, notes, files, and activities tied to that lead.

![insightly crm lead details](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-lead-details.Crh8cDQF_Z1nK7Kf.webp)![insightly crm lead details](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-lead-details.Crh8cDQF_Z1nK7Kf.webp)

Leads can also be organized on a Kanban board according to what stage of the pipeline they’re in. Here, you have the same options as above, with the added ability to advance leads through stages using drag-and-drop.

![insightly crm kanban pipeline](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-lead-pipeline.BLgm0vua_1TWfx9.webp)![insightly crm kanban pipeline](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-lead-pipeline.BLgm0vua_1TWfx9.webp)

Leads progress through qualification stages until they reach the final stage— [conversion](https://support.insight.ly/en-US/Knowledge/article/1372)—at which point they turn into sales opportunities and appear in the Opportunities tab.

The opportunity management module functions much like a standard deal management system. Opportunities are displayed in a list or in Kanban view, with their values, related organizations, and current stage in the pipeline.

![insightly crm opportunity management](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-manage-opportunities.FJJtfPxZ_1mub8D.webp)![insightly crm opportunity management](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-manage-opportunities.FJJtfPxZ_1mub8D.webp)

### Email Sync

Insightly CRM features two-way email sync, or bidirectional email sync, as it’s called inside the tool. You can not only send and receive emails from inside your CRM, but also keep a complete record of all email correspondence.

Insightly also provides BCC mailboxes to help log emails. There is one for contacts and another for leads. By forwarding, BCCing, or CCing messages to these addresses, you can ensure the emails are automatically added to your CRM.

![insightly crm email records](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-email-logs.CPiN3WEL_Z21aR6d.webp)![insightly crm email records](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-email-logs.CPiN3WEL_Z21aR6d.webp)

### Collaboration

Insightly CRM comes equipped with a host of functionalities that let you work together across teams in your organization.

Besides simply adding seats for team members to use, the CRM software lets you assign contacts, leads, opportunities, and tasks to them. You can also leave comments for team members and ‘@’ them to get their attention.

Insightly CRM includes visibility settings that let you control who can see what inside the system. You can choose to make your records visible to other members of your organization or keep them private to your own CRM seat. The same applies to dashboards and reports.

And if you’re an administrator on the Professional or Enterprise plans, you’ll be able to decide which seats (or users) can view, edit, or manage records.

### Duplicate Management

In Insightly CRM, there are two ways to deal with duplicate records: manually or automatically.

The former works when you’re well aware of any duplicate records in your CRM system. Simply go to one of the duplicates, select the Merge function, type in the name of the other duplicate, and you’re good to go.

The latter is dubbed [SmartMerge](https://support.insight.ly/en-US/Knowledge/article/1307), and it’s best for when you have reason to believe there’s a duplicate record. Go to a record’s page and choose the SmartMerge option, and the tool will automatically look for duplicates of that particular record. If found, you’ll be prompted to merge them into one record.

![insightly crm duplicate management](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-merge-duplicates-1.qCzHz8hD_Z1Q3dPj.webp)![insightly crm duplicate management](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-merge-duplicates-1.qCzHz8hD_Z1Q3dPj.webp)

That said, this CRM can also scan your entire database for all duplicate records in your system. The only catch is that the results won’t appear in your CRM; they’re sent to you by email, instead.

### Dashboard and Reporting

As the name implies, Insightly CRM is big on reporting and business insights. From the lowest plan, you can create reports based on parameters of your choosing (customizable reports).

![insightly crm reports](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-customizable-reports.BgP2Jf4J_23cJOx.webp)![insightly crm reports](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-customizable-reports.BgP2Jf4J_23cJOx.webp)

You can also visualize your sales funnel’s KPIs in dashboards. These dashboards can be built from scratch by combining various cards and using 40+ chart types and drag-and-drop layouts.

![insightly crm dashboard](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-dashboard.CZKGX4Ok_Z2uT36J.webp)![insightly crm dashboard](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-dashboard.CZKGX4Ok_Z2uT36J.webp)

When you log into Insightly, you’ll land on the homepage containing all your dashboards.

### Automations

Automations in Insightly can be confusing. On the lowest plan, you only get access to something called [Configurable Automated Workflows](https://support.insight.ly/en-US/Knowledge/article/1407), which are essentially task and event templates. They work more like Activity Sets—predefined groups of tasks you can quickly apply to a contact, project, or opportunity to save time.

The more advanced option, Complete Workflow Automation, is only available on higher-tier plans. This feature is closer to what most people expect from true workflow automation, since it lets you build workflows that trigger based on conditions and actions.

![insightly crm automated workflows](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-workflow-automation.D7HJneBx_ZAosw9.webp)![insightly crm automated workflows](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-workflow-automation.D7HJneBx_ZAosw9.webp)

Insightly also includes automatic lead capture to cut down on manual entry. With the browser extension, you can pull lead details directly from your Gmail inbox and turn them into CRM records. Leads can also be captured through web forms built into the platform.

Another feature is the built-in AI assistant. It can summarize emails and even help draft replies.

However, there is no built-in email sequencing tool on any of Insightly’s subscription plans. If you need that feature, you’ll need to integrate a third-party marketing app like Mailchimp or buy Insightly’s email marketing software.

### Integrations

There are tons of integration options available on Insightly CRM. You can sync with Google, Microsoft, PandaDoc, QuickBooks, Xero, and more than 540 business apps on the marketplace.

The small business CRM also integrates with AWS Lambda, AppConnect, and Webhooks to facilitate integrations with many other business apps. However, this custom integration feature is not available on the lowest plan; you’ll need a Professional or Enterprise plan.

![insightly crm app marketplace](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-integrations.DzTjSbIW_19BdIm.webp)

### Mobile App

Insightly, like many other small business CRMs, has mobile apps available on Android and iOS devices.

With these applications, you can access your entire CRM system from anywhere. That means everything, from contact and lead management to pipelines, dashboards, emails, and more.

Moreover, Insightly’s mobile CRM comes with a business card scanner for capturing contact details directly into your database. It also automatically syncs your CRM’s contacts and calendar with your phone’s. There’s also a tool for creating voice notes and audio reminders.

### Project Management and Time Tracking

Besides sales, Insightly also comes equipped with project management functionality.

It functions similarly to the Sales Opportunities module. All projects are organized in a list, along with their status, assigned team member, and project pipeline stage (which is separate from the sales pipeline). And when you click on a project, you get a 360º view of its details.

![insightly crm project management](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-manage-projects.BiGNZVG__Z16Q9rv.webp)![insightly crm project management](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-manage-projects.BiGNZVG__Z16Q9rv.webp)

There is also a dedicated [time tracking](https://support.insight.ly/en-US/Knowledge/article/8519) module. It includes a built-in timer to measure how long you spend on projects and tasks already in your CRM. You also have the option of logging work hours manually.

![insightly crm time tracker](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-time-tracker.CJM1ti_4_Z1dcVvF.webp)![insightly crm time tracker](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-time-tracker.CJM1ti_4_Z1dcVvF.webp)

## Ease of Use

Insightly CRM has a fairly intuitive interface.

The design is clean, the tabs are well organized, and their labels clearly describe the data they contain. The color scheme and text layout also support readability.

The challenge is that Insightly is overbloated. The main navigation has up to twelve tabs, which is a lot for small businesses that want something quick and easy to use.

On top of that, Insightly layers in extras like time tracking and project management, which just make the CRM system harder to learn and use.

And although the visual representations of your business health are genuinely helpful, the reporting and dashboard features are so extensive that setting them up and using them efficiently can be time-consuming.

Another point of concern is the CRM’s flexibility. Insightly is a highly customizable platform that allows you to not only configure your CRM system, but also enable or disable certain features. All these customization options can be too overwhelming for less CRM-savvy teams.

On [G2](https://www.g2.com/products/insightly-crm/reviews), Insightly holds an average rating of 4.2 out of 5 from more than 920 users. Many reviewers note that while the software is generally user-friendly, onboarding and setup often take longer than expected. Some even reported spending [months](https://www.g2.com/products/insightly-crm/reviews?utf8=%E2%9C%93&order=g2_default&filters%5Bsentiment_snippet%5D=1564351) trying to get comfortable with the system.

## Customer Support

Customer support in this small business CRM isn’t tied to your subscription plan. You get equal access to customer care across all plans, even the free trial.

The support comes in the form of:

- Chatbot
- Livechat
- Email support

You can also get assistance via phone call, but that’s only available from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. on weekdays.

## Insightly CRM Pricing Structure

Insightly CRM does not have a freemium. It has three subscription plans: Plus, Professional, and Enterprise.

Features are spread across each tier, and there are no add-ons or extras to extend any functionality. That means if a plan doesn’t have what you need, you’ll either have to upgrade, integrate a third-party app, or find a different CRM for your small business.

### How Much Does Insightly CRM Cost?

The lowest plan (Plus) covers the basics you’d expect of a CRM for small business. But at $29 per user/month, it’s more expensive than most other alternatives.

![insightly crm pricing plans](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-pricing.C09UgHVq_Z1lPw4A.webp)![insightly crm pricing plans](https://www.onepagecrm.com/_astro/insightly-crm-pricing.C09UgHVq_Z1lPw4A.webp)

Even more so, when you consider that it lacks workflow automations and email sequences. For this, you’ll need to opt for the next plan (Professional), which is also overpriced ($49 per user/month) and still doesn’t feature any email sequences.

And it makes no difference if you decide to opt for the Enterprise subscription at $99 per seat/month. Email sequencing doesn’t exist in this CRM. Period. If the functionality is important to you, you have three choices:

- Integrate a marketing app like Mailchimp
- Buy Insightly’s own email marketing product
- Or opt for another CRM

Insightly does not offer a freemium plan, but it does provide a 14-day free trial. The trial, however, gives you access to the Professional plan features, regardless of whether you are interested in the lowest or highest tier.

One good thing about Insightly is its generosity with file storage. The small business CRM provides 10GB of space on the lowest plan, and more than 10 times that amount on the higher subscriptions.

### Is Insightly an Affordable CRM for Small Business?

The short answer is no, not really.

At $29 per user each month, Insightly is almost twice the price of many small-business CRMs.

You would expect premium features for that cost, but email sequences are not even included. Many competing CRMs at half the price offer that as a standard feature.

The same applies to a core tool like workflow automation. If you’ll be needing that, you’ll have to move up to the $49 per user/month plan. For a small team of five people, that comes to $245 per month. That is a steep bill for functionality that [cheaper CRMs](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/best-affordable-crms/) include right out of the box.

Insightly only offers a 14-day trial, which is often not enough time to properly import your data, get set up, and test how the system works for your team.

Unless your business relies on having project management built directly into your CRM, Insightly’s pricing will feel expensive and difficult to justify for most small businesses.

## Final Verdict: Is Insightly the Best CRM for Small Business?

Insightly CRM does many things well. The reporting is solid, file storage is generous, and having projects integrated with sales can streamline operations.

For businesses that actually need CRM and project management in one system, Insightly might work. You get everything under one roof, which could simplify your tech stack.

But most small businesses just need to manage contacts, track deals, and follow up with leads. For them, all of Insightly’s offerings might seem like overkill. Not to mention it’s too expensive, takes too long to learn, and still manages to miss basic features like email sequences.

According to our criteria (Value, Impact, and Speed), **Insightly’s** fit for small businesses is **Low**.

## Best Alternative for Insightly CRM

If Insightly isn’t looking like the CRM for your small business, it’s worth checking out [OnePageCRM](https://www.onepagecrm.com/).

**Value:** High

**Impact:** High

**Speed:** High

**Pricing starts from**: $9.95

OnePageCRM takes the opposite approach from Insightly. Instead of trying to do everything, it focuses on one thing: helping you carry out sales actions that move deals forward and ultimately grow your business.

OnePageCRM features a [project delivery](https://help.onepagecrm.com/article/732-delivery-pipeline) functionality. But unlike Insightly, it does not use that as an excuse to charge you a premium price. And in contrast to Insightly, the feature isn’t for managing projects in the general sense. Rather, it helps you [deliver client projects](https://www.onepagecrm.com/blog/project-management-crm/) after you’ve won the sales deal.

At $9.95 per user/month, you’re paying about a third of Insightly’s cost, and you still get access to workflow automations.

Best of all, as the simplest CRM on the market, OnePageCRM gives you a plug-and-play system you can learn and set up in a few hours.
